text:
sasha: Quick sync 1  I dropped a 'What's New' blurb for the next docs deploy. Need a fast sweep: SDK snippet parity, one-line platform note for Dedicated, and any "Known issues" we should call out. PTAL :eyes:
rachel: Linking it?
sasha: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/whatsnew/3469-draft  Two quick heads-ups: embeddings API has been renamed in the runtime to `embeddings.create_v2` (samples need updating) and we discovered a quantization variance on older GPUs for sequences > 2k.
tim: I can take the Python and go minimal for the whatsnew inline. For the migration guide I can add a full example later. Do we want single-line or 2-3 line snippets?
sasha: Inline: keep to 1-3 lines. Full examples belong in the SDK migration guide and the repo examples.
rachel: I'll update the Python and JS snippets. Proposed Python inline: `resp = client.embeddings.create_v2(model=\"rwd-embed-1\", input=[\"hello\"])` 
tim: JS inline suggestion: `const resp = await client.embeddings.createV2({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: ['hello'] });` 
leo: For Known issues: add a short blurb: "Quantized models on older GPUs may produce minor logit diffs for sequences longer than ~2048 tokens; recommend re-eval for critical scoring pipelines." Link to bug tracker: https://bugs.internal/RED-2146
sasha: Good. Also need one line under Platform changes for Dedicated customers about a slight tightening of the latency SLO for small-batch interactive traffic, link to dedicated changelog entry and a contact CTA. Make it enterprise-visible only.
rachel: I'll add the enterprise note and add the quantization callout in Known issues. Also found a dead anchor: rollout-policy anchor in the routing doc 404s. I'll run linkcheck after edits.
devex-bot: PR #8394 results: linkcheck: failed (rollout-policy anchor not found), lint: passed, staging build: queued. Details: https://ci.internal/builds/8394
leo: Thanks bot. Rachel, after your fix can you run the link-checker locally and push? I'll re-run staging linkcheck and a quick QA sweep (snippet render, fenced code formatting).
rachel: Fix pushed: updated snippets, repaired rollout-policy anchor, added Known issues paragraph and Dedicated note. Ran linkcheck locally, no failures. Pushed commit 4a7b2c.
sasha: Nice. Leo, can you run the internal preview and confirm the inline snippet rendering and that the embed migration link points to the migration guide?
leo: Previewed on staging. Inline snippets render fine, migration link resolves. Found one micro-issue: JS snippet casing should be consistent with client lib naming (createV2 vs create_v2). We prefer camelCase in JS. Tim, can you update the JS snippet to use createV2 in the whatsnew inline and add a note in the migration guide about JS naming differences?
tim: Will send a tiny PR to the migration guide and update the inline to camelCase.
sasha: Excellent. Timeline: if staging clears, plan publish Tuesday 10:00 PT. Rachel, can you also add a short troubleshooting tip for customers who see quantization drift (recommend re-run evaluation with full-precision on a subset)? Keep it 1-2 lines under Known issues.
rachel: Added troubleshooting tip and linked to RED-2146. Also included a short callout about fallback routing staying stable for pinned model versions.
leo: Re-ran staging linkcheck: all green. QA sweep: snippets, anchors, and the enterprise note look good. Ready for merge unless Sasha wants more copy polish.
sasha: Looks good to me. Merge and schedule publish. Thanks team! :tada:
